## What's new

- A new UI Theme, ChaOS Pixel Names: no cards, just each console's name,
  large in the middle of the screen in the logo's pixel letters, with a
  glow and drop shadow in the console's colour. The name you land on
  flies together pixel by pixel, the one you leave scatters away.
- The card theme from 0.10.0 is now called ChaOS Pixel Cards (your
  choice is kept). Transition Speed works with both.

---

ChaOS 0.11.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.11.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.11.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
